title: Tap & Pay motion pilot: card mein battery nahi?
topic: Contactless card payments, NFC power, transaction proof and mobile wallet tokens
audience: Curious Hinglish-speaking viewers who want a simple explanation of everyday payment technology
takeaway: A passive contactless card has no battery, so the payment mystery is set up for the full NFC explanation.

sources.title: NFC Forum: Technical Overview
sources.supports: Short-range NFC communication, power transfer for battery-less operation, contactless card protocols and mobile card emulation. No exact range or charging-power claims in this reel.

beats.title: Card mein battery nahi.
beats.speech: Card में battery नहीं होती। फिर machine पर tap करते ही payment कैसे हो जाती है? चलो, एक coffee खरीदकर समझते हैं।
beats.caption: Card mein battery nahi hoti. Phir machine par tap karte hi payment kaise ho jaati hai? Chalo, ek coffee khareedkar samajhte hain.

beats.title: Coffee: Rs 200.
beats.speech: Cashier ने machine पर दो सौ रुपये डाले। आपने amount देखा और अपना contactless card पास लाए। अब अंदर क्या होता है?
beats.caption: Cashier ne machine par do sau rupaye daale. Aapne amount dekha aur apna contactless card paas laaye. Ab andar kya hota hai?
